name: Pavlov
source:
A member of The Laboratory and [url=/c34604]Milgram's[/url] right-hand man. A formidable Necromancer in his own right.

Despite his bulky frame, he is capable of extremely agile, unpredictable movement via the use of CNT wires.

[From the in-game profile]
